prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Paint the supplied paint_mask_guide.png, using design_reference.png as the approved material/detail reference and icon_x8.png as the original colour reference (ignore its magenta background).
Output ONE transparent PNG on a 1536x2048 3:4 canvas, or nearest 3:4 size. The guide is three columns by FOUR rows of square cells. Rows 1-2 and 3-4 repeat the same five exact model orthographic silhouettes: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty. Preserve EVERY object's exact position, size, outline, gaps and openings. Paint grey pixels only; do not redraw, move, enlarge or redesign. The thin edge-on views must stay thin.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base colour. Preserve ornate recurved orange wooden limbs, dark-gold bands, pale string, silver-blue grip, hooked tips. Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference scaled to each view. No lighting, cast shadows, AO, hot highlights, reflections.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: identical silhouettes, filled with FLAT pure colours only. Every metal part including gold/silver/steel/brass = #FF0000 red. Every leather/fur = #00FF00 green. Every cloth/cord/hair = #0000FF blue (bow string is cord). Every matte non-metal solid including wood/bone/horn = #FFFF00 yellow. Every gemstone/crystal/glass/pearl/enamel/liquid through glass = #000000 black. Every silhouette pixel gets exactly one class colour. No shading, texture, outlines, or antialiased colour blends inside masks.
All background and all openings fully transparent. Column 3 of rows 2 and 4 stays completely empty. No ground, labels, text, grid, borders, halo, sparkles or aura. Only the 10 guide objects in their exact guide positions.
CORRECTIVE GENERATION: Strictly retain guide alpha silhouettes. All colour must be clipped inside the original grey objects. Absolutely no stray red/yellow pixels, paint flecks, speckles, coloured fringes or marks outside objects or in openings. PAINT rows contain only natural material colours, no material-mask colours. MASK rows have clean exact flat fills. Preserve the precise guide shapes, including slim edge-on views. Do not add decorative hooked shapes to edge-on silhouettes. Transparent background.
